subject: POC load preflight — request for temporary credit buffer and 48h extension

From: Alice Wu <alice@atlaspay.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: credit buffer + 48h trial extension for POC surge run

Alex —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. To recap on our side: our engineering team will run a sustained surge (8–12h sustained at 180 QPS, repeated over a 48h window) to validate end-to-end latency and cache behavior for our payment reconciliation feature. The current free trial allocation will exhaust midway through the second window unless we get a top-up.

Can Redwood provision a temporary credit buffer and extend the trial window by 48 hours? Ideally we need an additional ~75,000 token-equivalent credits and the ability to run the dedicated stress endpoint (we discussed the read-only KV caching flag). We can sign a mutual action plan and share the load-run schedule.

Attachments: poc-load-plan.pdf (high-level traffic profile)

Thanks —
Alice

Head of Platform Integrations
AtlasPay

Looping you both in — AtlasPay is planning a sustained surge test across a 48h window and asked for ~75k token credits and an extension of the trial. They also want access to the dedicated stress endpoint and the KV caching toggle for more realistic caching behavior.

- Risk: higher than usual token draw during the 48h window; need to confirm SLA exception for burst.

Alice — I can provision an initial tranche as soon as we get internal OK; please confirm exact run start time (timezone) and the IPs that will hit the endpoint.

Dylan — can finance clear the remaining 25k as a one-off promotional uplift? If yes, please confirm method (promo grant vs. invoice credit) and whether we need procurement sign-off first. I want to avoid delaying the customer's run; they are doing a tight engineering window next week.

- Credit top-up: 75,000 token-equivalent applied to trial (one-time grant).
- Window: 2026-08-18 00:00 PDT through 2026-08-20 00:00 PDT.
- Endpoint: stress.redwood.ai/atlaspay-poc (read-only KV caching enabled for the run). Whitelisted IPs: 52.14.23.180, 18.205.33.4 (please confirm if others).
- Terms: one-time promotional uplift; credits expire at window end. No additional charges will be billed automatically unless you convert to Dedicated/Committed capacity.

Attachments: poc-load-plan.pdf (received), sla-exception-approval.pdf (internal authorization).

Next steps: please confirm final run start time and the list of test worker IPs. I'll have Soojin monitor infra and surface telemetry to you and to our CS dashboard. If you want a short sync before start, I can schedule a 15-min handoff.

Thanks and good luck with the run —
